title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fifty thousand Pesos for the Relief of Sufferers From Public Calamities.

text.en:
The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, for the purposes set forth in Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and nine of the
Philippine Legislature and its amendments.

The said sum of fifty thousand pesos shall be available until totally expended, and shall be
disbursed in accordance with the provisions of the aforesaid Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and nine and its
amendments.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, April 19, 1910.
